summary: First full test run for Frank El Gizawy Party MVP. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass covering auth (login OK/bad/me/unauth), public content/questions/stats/bot-status, applications submit+approve+reject with member creation, members CRUD, points delta with rank auto-recompute + clamp to 0, ranks CRUD, content/questions/settings PUT with persistence, and unauthenticated access rejected. Frontend Playwright: Home renders Arabic title/subtitle + fixed rules + live stats; Rules page loads; Apply form submits and shows success screen; Login wrong password shows toast/error and stays on /login; correct login navigates to /admin; Applications tab shows pending and both Approve & Reject work; Members tab add + delete works; Points tab + and - buttons update points and rank; Ranks tab add works; Editor tab saves content and questions; Discord tab saves settings; logout returns to /login; visiting /admin while logged out redirects to /login. No blocking issues found.

issues: Public pages (Home/Rules/Apply) trigger a /api/auth/me call that returns 401 for unauthenticated users, producing console errors. Not user-facing but noisy; could suppress 401 log or skip me() when no token/cookie is known.

critical_code_review_comments: Login brute-force lockout resets locked_until on EVERY failed attempt (server.py ~L260) — after 5 failures each subsequent wrong attempt keeps pushing the 15-min window forward. Consider only setting locked_until when count crosses the threshold, not on every failure.
resolve_rank falls back to ranks[0] when no rank matches (should never happen if a 0-min rank exists) but sorting is not guaranteed there — safer to sort by min_points first.
CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with FRONTEND_URL from env is fine, but the fallback 'http://localhost:3000' is duplicated in the list; harmless but a code smell.
Public /api/content and /api/questions do no null-check if seed didn't run (rare); a 500 would occur if docs missing. Consider guarding with defaults.
AuthContext appears to call /auth/me on every page load without a token check, generating 401 console errors on public pages.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed applications, members, ranks; approved-flow members remain in DB (used TEST_ prefix for easy cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_frank_party.py runs green in ~3s. Note: repeated wrong-password logins from same IP will lock admin for 15 minutes (429). If lockout hit, clear via: `mongo test_database --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})'`. Discord bot is intentionally not implemented — settings tab just persists config. All data-testids listed in the review request are present in the DOM.
